transcript: Speaker A: Hello, my name is Shobhit. I have come here to apply for admission to class 9th. Mathematics is my favorite subject. I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English. [Wow! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English.] Speaker A: सर, 'I give you' नहीं, 'I will give you' a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English. [Sir, not 'I give you', 'I will give you' a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English.] Speaker B: अच्छा! अभी डाउनलोड करता हूँ बेटा English Seekho app. [Okay! I will download the English Seekho app right now, son.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority or brand, and results may vary based on individual effort.]
summary: A young boy impresses a school interviewer with his fluent English, attributing his skills to the English Seekho app. The boy then humorously corrects the interviewer's grammar, prompting him to download the app. The ad encourages viewers to install the app to improve their English.
